name: conveyor-belt
description: Issue-to-merged-commit automation for Claude Code: one issue becomes one card, built in a fresh worktree, reviewed, tested, landed, and pushed when you choose.

boardAutoOpen.title: Open the Board at start
boardAutoOpen.description: Open the Conveyor Board in the browser when a session starts in a repo with a Conveyor pack, and when a session becomes the Foreman. When the Board is not running, conveyor.sh board starts it first.

pane.title: Side pane and toasts
pane.description: The Conveyor pane: every section of /units, one line an item; and the toasts for a card that newly needs you or lands. auto: on in main, where the Foreman runs, off in worker panes.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Turns the mark of each card on the belt once a second. off: the mark stands still.

time.title: Time
time.description: How the pane writes a time of day: 12-hour (3:04 PM) or 24-hour (15:04). Where the Board runs on this machine, the Time last set in its Customize is used instead.
